result.question: Where did the old prophet bury the body of the man of God?

readings.support: his own city to mourn for him and bury him

assessments.reason: Verse 30 explicitly says, “Then he laid the body in his own tomb,” which directly answers the question.
Verse 29 says he brought the body to his own city “to…bury him,” and verse 30 shows the burial in his own tomb; thus the burial occurred in his own city, though the precise location is his tomb.
